method: Four phrases per county: web design and SEO for the county and a consistently selected municipality. Two statewide phrases and 36 supplemental city/sector phrases. Not an exhaustive market inventory.
limitations: US monthly estimates for those phrases are not county-resident demand.
Unavailable values are unknown, not zero.
A positive estimate does not independently justify a separate page.
Provider usage metadata is preserved as returned, including a negative value; no total cost is inferred.

anchorSource.selection: Largest incorporated municipality intersecting the county, by 2025 Census population estimate; whole-place population is used for cross-county municipalities. Alphabetical CDP fallback only if no municipality exists; unused for Florida. This is a consistent query sample, not an exhaustive list of local commercial centers.
